contact.basis: Dry central Great Courtyard, open to sky and separate from roof/interior returns. Independent original GeoSN ground controls this datum before geometry.

verticalDatum: DHHN2016 / EPSG:7837; source GeoSN DGM1, projected ETRS89 / UTM33N EPSG:25833
method: Original1m Float32 DGM cell-centre heights bilinearly resampled to2m review grid. Signed local coordinates converted via GRS80 transverse Mercator to EPSG25833; no building geometry participates. No fitting or flattening.
limitations: DGM ground beneath buildings is interpolated; source epoch2024-11-30. Review is not an engineering survey.
WGS84/ETRS89 frame differences, approximate local111320m/degree conversion and source interpolation limit positional accuracy.
Compatible host terrain is required; default coarse Terrarium is not certified.
